<thought>Based on the observed isotopic pattern (M+1 ≈8 % and M+2 ≈0.5 % of the monoisotopic peak) the distribution matches that expected for carbon atoms (≈1.1 % per 13C). No other element shows a characteristic pattern (e.g., Cl would give ~24 % M+2). Therefore carbon is the only element that can be definitively identified.</thought>
<final_answer>['C']</final_answer>
